acquisition_policy: Do NOT acquire large new datasets during the active FP-CONTROL-1 run. Document requirements only.

additional_data_needed: Binance perpetual funding-rate history covering the full test range
candidates.qa_requirement: Funding is a futures-venue metric used only as a filter input; no futures execution is implied. Needs its own publication-time audit: the value must be the last PUBLISHED funding value at each decision bar, never an interpolated or future one.

additional_data_needed: 4h candles (derivable from 1h by aggregation, subject to a reconciliation audit)
candidates.qa_requirement: 1h->4h aggregation must reconcile exactly on OHLC, as the 5m->1h check already does

additional_data_needed: 40-80 (README) up to 160 (shipped static pairlist) Binance spot USDT pairs
5m candles for every pair across the full range
15m, 1h, 4h and 1d informative candles for every pair
candidates.storage_estimate: Dataset V2 stores ~21 MB per pair for 5m over ~5.7 years. 80 pairs at 5m is roughly 1.7 GB before informative timeframes; 160 pairs with four extra timeframes is materially larger. An estimate, not a measurement.
candidates.qa_requirement: Per-pair listing-date handling, delisted-pair survivorship bias, and a full audit per pair
candidates.blocker: DO NOT BUILD DURING THE ACTIVE FP RUN.

survivorship_warning: Any multi-pair universe must be built from a point-in-time listing set. Using today's top-volume pairlist over a 2020-2026 backtest would silently select coins that survived and succeeded, which is a far larger effect than any strategy edge under test.
